name: Imanishi Miyuki
source:
A mature married woman living in the neighboring apartment on the right. She works part-time at a lunch vendor. She's a caring and good-natured person who often teases the protagonist for being such a young man. The ennui between her and her husband bothers her.

[translated from [url=http://www.r18game.com/tougenkyo/ryotonari/chara.html]official website[/url]]
